lines.zh: 我四条短腿小跑，一跳一跳。
lines.en: I trot on four short legs, bouncing as I go.

lines.zh: 我跟在主人脚边，不远不近。
lines.en: I keep near my master's feet, not too close.
I circle a stone.
I run toward the grassy slope.

lines.zh: 我腿短，跑起来晃得厉害。
lines.en: My legs are short and I wobble as I run.
I hop along all the way over.
I circle around my anchor.
I run back to my master.
I stop and puff out a breath.
I run toward the sound.
I step over a small twig.
I work my way to the front of the line.
I sit with my ears twitching.
I look up at my master.
My head tips to one side.
I wait quietly without moving.
I gurgle once.
I set my two forepaws together.
I hear a sound far off.
I lick my own paw.
I sit up very straight.
I want to run, and hold myself back.

lines.zh: 我朝风来的方向闻了闻。
lines.en: I sniff toward the wind.
I wag my tail gently.
I wait for someone to call me.
I tuck myself in tight.
I look up at you, eyes bright.
Are you my master?
I run two steps up to you.
I stop and tilt my head.
I sniff at your shoe.
You reach out and I lean in.
I sit and wait to be petted.
You carry the smell of a stranger.
I run a circle round you.
I call out twice running.
Where are you taking me?
I press close to your leg.
I am not afraid of you.
I look up and wait for you to speak.
I roll over in front of you.
I take a step with you.
I cry out in pain.
The blow rolls me over.
I tuck myself in tight.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，四条腿发软。
lines.en: I ball up, all four legs gone weak.
I run toward my master.
I whimper once.
I hide behind your heels.
I push myself up slowly.

lines.zh: 这一下我记在小身子上。
lines.en: I keep that in this small body.
All four legs are still up.
That smells like In-Training food.
I bounce over to it.
I eat it in one bite.
I lick the bowl clean.

lines.zh: 我又抬头看看还有没有。
lines.en: I look up for more.
This is very good.

lines.zh: 我吃的时候尾巴一直在摇。
lines.en: My tail wags the whole time I eat.
I carry it off to one side.
I get it all over my face.
Done, I wipe my mouth.
I eat beside your feet.
You open your hand and I lean in.
One knock and I roll over.
I get up and shake my head.
I slip to your other side.
I am small and a bump hurts.
I back up two steps.
I run back to your feet.

lines.zh: 我撞在你的腿上，弹开了。
lines.en: I hit your leg and bounce off.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩被撞歪的身子。
lines.en: I shake my knocked-about body straight.
I look up at you, a little hurt.
I shift to the side.
I do not understand this yet.
I tilt my head and look at you.
I run off.
I am still young.
I only want to play.
I run two little circles.
I sit where I am.
I turn and take another way.
I shake my head.
I yelp once and run.
I pick up a little piece.
I carry it in my mouth.

lines.zh: 这一块太硬，牙口啃不动。
lines.en: This is too hard for my teeth.
I drag it into my nest.
I swallowed it.
It dropped out of my mouth.
I keep it for slow eating.
That does not taste right.
I carry it to my master.
I find another piece.
Something is coming near me.
My ears prick up.
I retreat toward my master.
I have that outline.
I flatten my body down.
I show my teeth.
It is smaller than I am.
It is touching my things.
I prepare to pounce.
I bark at it once.
I spread my forepaws.
I shift half a step toward it.
I stare at it hard.
It moves a foot and I move.
I come round on its flank.
I dare not pounce first.
I wait for it to leave a gap.
My tail is stretched dead stiff.
It yielded half a step.
I creep a little closer.
I glance back at my master.
It is still where it was.
I press flat to the ground.

lines.zh: 它一转身，我就换个位置。
lines.en: When it turns, I change position.
I pounce and bite it.
I leap and bump it.
My teeth are not large.

lines.zh: 我咬空了，牙磕在硬壳上。
lines.en: I snapped at air and my teeth struck hard shell.
It pushes and I roll over.
I pounce once more.
I shoulder it away.
I pant and stay upright.
I retreat to my master's feet.
I have stopped.
I bite its toes.
I call out as I pounce.
I tumble out of the light.
I sit on the grass.
The wind moves my ears.
I look all around.
It is bright here.
I need to find my master.
I take two steps and sit again.
I sniff the ground.
The grass is soft.
I called once and no one answered.
I shift under the tree.
I stay here without moving.

lines.zh: 火烫到我的毛，我满地打滚。
lines.en: Fire singes my fur and I roll on the ground.

lines.zh: 我落地时腿一软，趴下了。
lines.en: My legs give on landing and I flatten out.
Water rushes into my nose and I kick wildly.

lines.zh: 炸响把我抛起来，我滚了好几圈。
lines.en: The blast throws me and I tumble.
This thing pinned my leg.

lines.zh: 一股冷意包住我，我抖个不停。
lines.en: Cold wraps me and I keep shivering.

lines.zh: 太饿了，我连叫都叫不出来。
lines.en: Too hungry to even cry out.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我整只都木了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I go all numb.
I fall away.
